rec.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include “inventory.stock.view”. Ask an administrator if you need it.
rec.dockHint: The thread beside this page (wide screens)
rec.noPanels: Your role does not read threads.

mv.intro: Every move of the ledger that names it, newest first. Moves are never edited: a mistake is reversed on Movements.
mv.noneBody: Nothing in the ledger names it yet.

record.name: Hide
record.notFoundBody: This hide does not exist or belongs to another company.
record.title: Hide {code}
record.consumed: Consumed: nothing of this hide is left
record.scrapped: Scrapped: this hide left the stock
record.readOnly: It is kept for traceability: its cuts and moves stay as they were.

list.search: Tag, tannery number or lot — or scan a tag
list.emptyBody: Hides come in one by one with their receipt, each with its own measured area.

hd.atCutting: At the cutting table, not in stock

print.notPrintable: Tag {code} is not a code this factory prints: it cannot be printed.
print.printersFailed: The printers couldn't be read: the tags can still be downloaded as a PDF.
print.noPrinter: No label printer at this site
print.noPrinterBody: The tags are made as a PDF that the browser prints (the same label, 100 × 50 mm).
print.oneSite: Tags of one site at a time: select hides of one site.
print.noRight: Your role does not print labels.
print.someHeld: A consumed or scrapped hide gets no tag: leave it out.
print.consumed: Consumed: nothing of it is left to tag.
print.scrapped: Scrapped: nothing of it is left to tag.
print.refused: The label was refused as it is (its tag or text).
print.sending: Sending the tags to the printer…
print.done: Every tag reached its printer or says why not.

facts.title: What this hide is
facts.readOnly: Measured at receipt and never changed here: a different area is an adjustment move; grade, shade and defects cannot be corrected from the office yet.

area.title: What happened to its area
area.elsewhere: At the work order, not cut yet: {area} ({share}%)
area.remnant: Of what is in stock, {area} came back as a remnant.
area.gap: These figures do not add up to the measured area: the cut log holds more than the hide. Tell the office.

defects.title: Defects
defects.photos: Photos of the hide come later: the office cannot add them yet.

side.title: Its lot and the next step

next.remnant: A remnant in stock: ready to cut.
next.atWorkOrder: At a work order: the cutting table works on it.
next.reserved: Reserved for {demand}: issued only to it.
next.reservedStale: Reserved for {demand}, which is done: release the reservation.

cuts.stationOnly: This site records the station only: no cut names a worker.
cuts.workerNamed: This site names the worker on each cut (legal basis on record); the name is shown only here, in this one record.
cuts.label: Cuts of hide {code}
cuts.noneBody: Cuts come from the cutting table, one entry each; they are never edited.

daily.reserve_one: Reserve {count} hide to a work order…
daily.reserve_other: Reserve {count} hides to a work order…

held.noReserve: Your role may not reserve stock (inventory.reserve).
held.oneSite: Hides of one site at a time: pick a site first.
held.noScrap: Your role may not scrap stock (inventory.scrap).
held.gone: A selected hide has nothing in stock (used up, scrapped or at a work order): take it out of the selection.
held.reservedAlready: Reserved already: release that reservation first.

record.name: Lot
record.notFoundBody: This lot does not exist or belongs to another company.
record.title: Lot {code}
record.noQuality: Your role does not include “quality.lots.view”: quality decides lots in Compliance › Tests & substances.
record.rejected: Rejected on {date}: final, its stock is never used.

list.search: Lot code, supplier lot or dye batch — or scan a lot label
list.emptyBody: Lots are made when goods are received (or with the opening stock).
list.decideWhere: Several lots that pass their checks are released here (select them: Release N lots); blocking, rejecting, a single release and the Cr VI result happen in Compliance › Tests & substances (row ⋯).

tileHint.crViFailed: At or above the limit: never issued

release.title: Release checklist
release.label: Release checks
release.noRight: The checklist is quality's: your role does not include “quality.lots.view”.
release.ready: Ready to release: every check passed.
release.readyUnblock: Ready to unblock: every check passed.
release.where: Read only here: a person with the quality role releases the lot in Tests & substances, typing its code (never the person who received it).

STATE.OK: the lot can be decided now
STATE.OPEN: its state does not allow this decision
STATE.isBLOCKED: blocked after its release: unblocked once the finding is cleared

RECEIPT.OPEN: its receipt is not posted (or was reversed)

CR_VI.OK: result recorded and below the limit
CR_VI.OPEN: no result yet, or at or above the limit
CR_VI.NOT_NEEDED: this material needs no Cr VI test

PPE_CERTIFICATE.OPEN: no valid certificate covers this PPE component yet

SUPPLIER_DOCUMENTS.OK: the documents it needs are here
SUPPLIER_DOCUMENTS.OPEN: a document it needs is missing or expired

HOLD.OPEN: the receiver held it for a check

RELEASER.OK: a person with the quality role may release it
RELEASER.OPEN: the person who received it may not release it

where.title: Where it is
where.nothing: Nothing of it is in stock.
where.issued_one: Issued to {count} work order: see Trace.
where.issued_other: Issued to {count} work orders: see Trace.
where.perSite: Reservations hold the lot at the site, not a place: see the site row.
where.figuresFailed: What is reserved could not be read.
where.overReserved: More of this lot is reserved than there is: release or move a reservation.
where.noReservations: No work order has reserved this lot.

side.title: Quality status
side.usable: Released: its stock can be issued.

trace.opening: Opening stock: it was in the warehouse before Nexus; no supplier receipt names it.
trace.notUsedBody: No work order took stock of this lot.
trace.ordersLabel: Work orders that took the lot
trace.noShipments: None of these work orders has shipped garments yet.
trace.far: The trace goes as far as the records do: from a work order to its shipments and customers. The trace tree below follows every link both ways, down to bundles and garments.

reject.title: Rejected, with stock still here: what happens to it?
reject.body: Send it back to the supplier (a claim with its return DDT and the credit expected) or write it off where it lies.
reject.noScrap: Your role may not write off stock (inventory.scrap).

quality.where: Release, block, reject and the Cr VI result are decided in Compliance › Tests & substances.
quality.noRight: Your role does not see quality holds (quality.holds.view).
quality.inspections: Incoming inspections of the lot come in a later release.
quality.noHoldsBody: No quality hold has named this lot or its hides.

find.title: Trace
find.subtitle: Backward and forward, from any code.
find.hint: A garment serial, a batch or work order number, a bundle ticket, a hide tag, a lot, a shipment or DDT number.
find.heldEmpty: Scan or type a code first.
find.unreadable: {code} is not a label the trace takes (a place, a carton, or another factory's label).
find.failed: The code could not be looked up.

tracePage.name: Trace
tracePage.title: Trace · {kind} {code}
tracePage.hint: Where it came from and where it went, read from the records now (nothing is stored).
tracePage.notFoundBody: The record does not exist, or belongs to a company or site you do not see.
tracePage.nothingBody: Open the trace from a code: Trace… finds the record.

tree.title: Trace tree
tree.intro: Backward and forward in one tree. What the records know only per work order or size says “may hold it”: a recall counts it too.
tree.label: Trace of {code}

gap.OPENING_STOCK: {at} came in as opening stock: no receipt or supplier DDT is on record.
gap.NO_SUPPLIER: {at} names no supplier and no receipt: where it came from is not known.
gap.NO_ISSUE: Work order {at} has nothing issued or cut on record: its lots are not known.
gap.BUNDLE_WITHOUT_CUTS: Bundle {at} names no cut: its hides are known only for its work order (listed as may hold it).
gap.SERIAL_WITHOUT_BUNDLE_one: {count} garment of {at} got its serial before its bundle was known: known only for the work order.
gap.SERIAL_WITHOUT_BUNDLE_other: {count} garments of {at} got their serial before their bundle was known: known only for the work order.
gap.LINE_WITHOUT_SERIALS_one: {count} garment on shipment {at} has no serial on record: known only by its size.
gap.LINE_WITHOUT_SERIALS_other: {count} garments on shipment {at} have no serial on record: known only by their size.
gap.BATCH_TRACKED: The garments of {at} carry the batch number, not a serial: every shipment of the size may hold it.
gap.ISSUED_BY_QUANTITY: {at}: material issued by quantity is recorded for the whole work order, not per garment (may hold it).
gap.SUBCONTRACT_RETURN: Subcontract order {at}: what came back is not linked garment by garment; every garment of its work order may hold it.
gap.ISSUED_NOT_CUT_one: {at} is issued to {count} work order and not cut yet: the trace ends there for now.
gap.ISSUED_NOT_CUT_other: {at} is issued to {count} work orders and not cut yet: the trace ends there for now.
gap.CUT_NOT_BUNDLED_one: {count} cut of {at} is in no bundle yet: the pieces are still in the cutting room.
gap.CUT_NOT_BUNDLED_other: {count} cuts of {at} are in no bundle yet: the pieces are still in the cutting room.
gap.SERIALS_COLLAPSED_one: {count} serial is counted on its bundle and size: trace the work order or the bundle to see it.
gap.SERIALS_COLLAPSED_other: {count} serials are counted on their bundles and sizes: trace the work order or a bundle to see each one.

tree.restricted_one: {count} record you may not see is counted, not shown ({permission}).
tree.restricted_other: {count} records you may not see are counted, not shown ({permission}).
tree.noAffected: No customer has received these goods.
tree.failed: The trace could not be read.

key.open: Open a level, or go into it
key.close: Close a level, or go out of it

rel.subtitle: {going} of {count} can be released now.
rel.tableLabel: The lots and their release checks
rel.ready: Every check passed: ready to release.
rel.nowUsable: Released: its stock is usable now.

why.failed: Its release check could not be read.
why.blocked: Blocked: unblock it in Tests & substances (another decision).

rel.reach_one: {count} lot becomes usable: planning nets it and the floor may issue it.
rel.reach_other: {count} lots become usable: planning nets them and the floor may issue them.
rel.reversal: To undo: block the lot in Tests & substances.

held.none: None of these lots can be released now.
held.noRight: Your role may not release lots (quality.lots.release).
held.pick: Select the lots to release first.

result.changed: It changed meanwhile (another decision, or a check reopened): read it again.
result.forbidden: Your role may not release this lot.
result.refused: Refused: a check is not met any more.
result.offline: No connection: it was not released.
result.failed: It was not released. Try again.
